question: In a certain code language, ‘TALK’ is coded as ‘5327’ and ‘LINE’ is coded as ‘6143’. What is the code for ‘L’ in the given code language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0270f2b5240d1e3915517248ac98d6d73ad611166857551401277421991a6c6e.png] 

The logic followed here is:

‘TALK’ is coded as ‘5327’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/038af7b0af9a11273fcf61ec4563d9a426f281cbb9eaeb1da8e2aa11ae2c7144.png] 

‘LINE’ is coded as ‘6143’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2c321ee4673f74e812f85d1b6f3d8fec4ef389f07aeb5137590d60b8df43cc92.png] 

So, '**3**' is the code for ‘L’ in the given code language.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
